scope: Public primary anatomy, clinical image and device evidence for integrated implementation. Research files only; no site source edits or publication.

conduct.retrieval: Exa mcporter missing. Jina local DNS unavailable. Used web search/open and verified-TLS public HTTP downloads. No CAPTCHA bypass, login, email, contact, payment or form submission.

visual_review.provenance: Clinical photographs reproduced in Atteya 2024 with named clinician attribution; chapter is educational synthesis, not a new normal-anatomy trial. F23/F29 credited to Gonzalez-Garcia; F34/F36/F38 to Monje Gil. F49/F50 are the chapter's procedural photographs.
observations: F23: broad pale/grey, taut medial lining with subtle vertical striae; no repeated large crumpled ridges.
F29/F49: posterior wall and rounded foreground margin form a continuous recess; elongated relief and vessels remain regionally restricted.
F34: smooth transition from vascular retrodiscal tissue into paler disc; the boundary is not a free triangular sheet.
F36: pale smooth disc in foreground occludes deeper vascular lining; discrete wet highlights coexist with low surface relief.
F38/F50: shallow anterior crease and broad smooth opposing surfaces; wall curvature and occlusion provide depth.
Clinical photographs vary substantially in white balance and exposure; matching one RGB tone is not anatomical validation.
visual_review.r46_observation: The live reference still has a broad angular dark wall, an acute basal valley and planar triangular lower shelves. The visible white region and wall meet in a crease whose geometry dominates the view. Shader continuity does not repair these silhouettes.
visual_review.rights: Research comparison only. No new clinical photographs projected as the camera scene. No permission to redistribute copyrighted photographs inferred from public access.

new_manufacturer_image.observation: Visible collar hub, angled irrigation side connection and marked slender shaft. The single photo lacks scale calibration, cross-section and seated telescope, so it supplies appearance only.

new_telescope_image.observation: Flared black eyepiece, elongated black neck, polygonal metal hub, angled lightpost, stepped distal collar and slim straight shaft. Appearance only; no component lengths inferred from pixels.

anatomy.title: Regional Anatomical Nomenclature and Arthroscopic Terminology in Human Temporomandibular Joints
facts: Temporary synovial folds can become less prominent with changed disc position; persistent plicae are distinguished.
Upper posterior pouch includes medial and lateral paradiscal grooves. Tongue-like plicae were observed behind the medial discal eminence in 11/20 joints.
The lower posterior pouch in opening forms a narrow deep groove; posterior lining shows underlying vascular fat-pad contours.
anatomy.locators: Printed pp749-752; figure captions pp754-758; Figures9-18.
anatomy.limits: Preserved cadavers, historical optics and nonregistered subjects. No current-head surface, contact state, imaging or motion law.
anatomy.access: Indexed primary full text read. Web PDF screenshots returned cache miss; direct public download repeatedly reset and is retained as .pdf.partial. It is not a valid or visually inspected PDF.

anatomy.title: Synovial plica, lateral impingement and intra-articular impingement/entrapment pathologies of the temporomandibular joint
anatomy.type: Review with authors' original clinical/cadaver figure data

mechanics.type: Original CT-arthrography/IAP and finite-volume study in one healthy individual
mechanics.finding: Opening reduced the anterior upper compartment while increasing posterior space; reported anterior pressure exceeded posterior pressure. This is regional redistribution, not uniform expansion.
mechanics.implementation: Use admitted geometry to recompute cavity volume. Treat rotation, translation and prescribed distraction as different inputs. Do not import the study's qualitative pattern as a calibrated movement law for a different head.
mechanics.access: Primary abstract read; no new registered meshes acquired.

mechanics.type: Original human lateral capsule-ligament tensile study
mechanics.finding: Anterior and posterior lateral capsule-ligament regions show different tensile behavior; the anterior region is stiffer at higher tested strains.
mechanics.implementation: Justifies regional material modeling if geometry/rest length/loading are known. Does not supply whole-capsule pressure inflation, synovial fold thickness, current-head pretension, or scope-force calibration.

mechanics.type: Original two-phase lavage simulation with clinical B12 concentration comparison
mechanics.finding: Eight models with0.8/2.4mm cannula sizes predict spatially uneven early replacement and low-flow regions.
mechanics.implementation: A uniform-pressure, well-mixed tracer model cannot reproduce that spatial behavior. Keep its reduced-system label. Do not use these different devices to calibrate Nexus resistance.
mechanics.source_discrepancy: 2016 IADR abstract reports25-27.5mL/30mL; final2017 article abstract reports109mL. Do not mix those thresholds or turn them into simulator treatment targets.

mechanics.finding: Original CFD used a rigid reconstructed wall and explicitly limited validity when pressure produces substantial capsule deformation.
mechanics.implementation: It does not validate a pressure-driven deformable joint. Existing r33 evidence already distinguishes source pressure, joint pressure, through-flow volume and retained volume.

implementation_recommendations: Inspect mesh triangle region labels at the actual lens-visible acute valleys and planes. Determine whether each is genuine hard anatomy, mixed boundary or a computational closure before smoothing.

Use a continuous attachment-constrained soft surface for estimated synovium; retain source bone/disc exactly. Round soft recesses without uniformly adding folds. Broad taut medial lining and smooth disc should stay distinct.

Any topology/position change must feed lens, locator, classification, section and volume from the same physical buffers. Repeat surface and movement collision audits, including intermediate states, not just end poses.

Clinical-image comparison should show the actual physical lens pose, tissue target, clipping/occlusion and brightness alongside the reference. It is a regional morphological comparison, not an exactly registered clinical camera match.
Retain full finite shaft/proximal guards, continuous accepted-prefix movement and outward recovery. Do not solve visual sheets by bypassing contacts or expanding hard anatomy.
Keep pressure and tracer state tied to admitted volume; do not redraw illustrative local fluid jets or vortices unless a spatial solver and its validation are actually added.
remaining_external_dependencies: Matched specimen high-resolution disc/capsule/synovial geometry and accepted contact state
Exact-model cannula/assembly controlled drawing or calibrated physical measurements
Human review of arthroscopic regional morphology
publication_boundary: This evidence supports better model design and honest provenance; it does not establish that the integrated simulator has achieved clinical realism.
